original_question: A gwara Morisette na Kael ka ha weta mkpụrụ osisi. Morisette wetara apụl  ise na oroma asatọ, ebe Kael wetara apụl ugboro abụọ na ọkara oroma karịa Morisette. Mkpụrụ osisi ole ka ha nwere na ngụkọta?
question_template: A gwara {name_female, Morisette} na {name_male, Kael} ka ha weta mkpụrụ osisi. {name_female, Morisette} wetara apụl {num_digit_1, 5} na oroma {num_digit_2, 8}, ebe {name_male, Kael} wetara apụl {num_text_1, ugboro abụọ} na {num_frac_1, ọkara} oroma karịa {name_female, Morisette}. Mkpụrụ osisi ole ka ha nwere na ngụkọta?
question_solution: answer = (1 + k) * num_digit_1 + (1 + f) * num_digit_2   # k = numeric value of num_text_1 (twice→2, thrice→3, …); f = numeric value of num_frac_1 (half→1/2, third→1/3, quarter→1/4, two-thirds→2/3, …)
